spawndetective.anchor.set: Anchored %s. Walk 25 blocks away, then right-click to read it.
spawndetective.anchor.none: Nothing anchored yet. Sneak-right-click the block you want to check, then walk 25 blocks away and right-click again.
spawndetective.anchor.elsewhere: The anchored block is in %s. Sneak-right-click a block here to move it.
spawndetective.probe.tip.anchor: Sneak-right-click a block to anchor it
spawndetective.probe.tip.read: Right-click to read, sneak in the air to clear
spawndetective.jei.probe.what: Tells you why a mob won't spawn on a block. Light, the floor, the mob cap, another mod blocking it: it checks the same rules the game does and names the one that stopped it.
spawndetective.jei.probe.anchor: Sneak-right-click the block you want to check, then walk 25 blocks away. Nothing spawns within 24 blocks of a player, and your own body takes up the space a mob needs.
spawndetective.jei.probe.read: Right-click anywhere to read it. Search for a mob or pick one off the list. It remembers your pick between blocks.
spawndetective.jei.probe.why: Green: it spawns here. Red: it never will. Yellow: something temporary is stopping it, like a full mob cap or you standing too close.
